TFT16_Aatrox.ability_description:
On cast, cycle through one of the following abilities:

Slash in a line, dealing 110/210/2500 () physical damage to enemies hit and 20% Sundering them for 4 seconds.

Swipe in a cone, dealing 132/252/3000 () physical damage to enemies hit and knocking them up for 1 second.

Slam on target, dealing 176/336/4000 () physical damage in a 1 hex circle. Targets below 15% max Health are executed.
